overview_description.description:
Salfny.com is a peer to peer online rental marketplace. Salfny allows you, both private and professional, to rent or lend any type of property belonging to you, which you don't use very much in your daily life.

You don't have to buy a product for a one-time need, Salfny offers a solution to rent near to home, the stuff of any kind. Need a roof box for a weekend, a sound or disguise for an evening, or even a gardening tool, just open Salfny.com and enter the desired object and the place of your search!

Who doesn’t own belongings like a bike, a skateboard, a camera and video gear, party furniture, a mower, a barbecue, a scooter, a baby stroller, textbooks, sporting goods, ladders, musical instruments, consumer electronics - absolutely anything. Most of us have all kinds of this stuff sitting around collecting dust and doing nothing, instead, we could be renting it out making money from it, just open Salfny.com and list all your dormant stuff for rent.

You can now make money from the things you have and save money on the things you want and need. Salfny will help you to cut down on the overall use of resources and make the best use of your stuff. There's a social green aspect as well because sharing things — even with strangers we have just met online — allows us to make meaningful social connections.

At Salfny, our mission is to promote peer-to-peer renting as opposed to buying as a new, sustainable and community-driven way of consuming. By reusing, and renting we can save natural resources from the growing consumption that occurs in the era we live in.
